bars.description: Candidate A–A–B–A–B: source writes A8+A8+B8; the recording suggests a da capo without repeating its first strain again. After the first complete traversal, return at the G-sharp pickup in bar8's last eighth, then bars9–24. Do not duplicate the complete AAB source as if the da capo retained its written-out initial repeat; verify both A/B returns independently.

endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch search windows from cached recording analysis; final onset positions and worst-region overlays must be inspected before publication.

provenance: Source MIDI tracks were inspected against the named score staves; staff labels do not claim contrapuntal voice separation. EXT: Leichte Stucke, 1900. MEAS: Correct work/movement catalogue number and original piano scoring. INFERENCE: The recording’s exact edition, repeat choices, cuts and ornaments remain unverified; do not use MIDI duration as evidence of equivalence.

Read content/listen/schumann-kinderszenen-happiness.mjs and cache/analysis/schumann-kinderszenen-happiness.txt. Harmonic trajectories suggest A0–28, B28–46, A46–68, B68–90; these are coarse, not forced alignment anchors.

Opened Henle critical notes p299, https://www.henle.de/media/05/bf/e6/1690899698/9924-1690899698-sync.pdf: FE2 writes repeats out; the D.C. at16 may be a manuscript remnant. This documents edition/order ambiguity, not proof of Betts's choice. The proposed return is subject to pitch/order inspection.

DCML reference harmony https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DCMLab/schumann_kinderszenen/main/harmonies/n05.harmonies.tsv confirms the borrowed F-major region (local bIII of D); no reference-corpus notes or harmony labels are copied into this Mutopia-derived score.
